gameDescriptionHtml:
Because deliveries also existed in medieval times, Medieval Delivery is a third-person simulation and adventure game where you’ll have the task of making deliveries throughout the village according to the requests of its inhabitants, such as meat, flour, bread, and perhaps other things.

We all know that delivery is a fundamental part of modern times. But why not imagine what it would have been like to carry out this activity in a medieval era?

Game Features

  • The World – Medieval Delivery is a simulation and adventure game. Embark on an exciting journey through a medieval world steeped in mystery and intrigue. Set in the bustling town of Thornridge, players assume the role of Alistair, a humble courier with a hidden past. As Alistair navigates picturesque landscapes and interacts with the town’s diverse inhabitants, he uncovers a web of secrets that threaten Thornridge’s tranquility.
  • Thorough Exploration – The expansive town of Thornridge and its surroundings hide secrets, treasures, and alternative routes that players can discover in multiple playthroughs. Delving into side character stories and parallel missions enriches the experience, encouraging players to delve deeper into the game world. Do you need more speed? Your horse will be your best friend in this adventure as it will allow you to move quickly across the entire map.
  • Variety of Missions – In Medieval Delivery, you can choose the type of missions you want to undertake. You have the option to build an honorable reputation by taking on tasks befitting a hero. On the other hand, you can delve into the world of acquiring things through less honest means, or, why not, do both.
  • Home – In your home, you can engage in various activities. First, you can decorate it according to your preferences. You can also sleep to advance time, cook dishes that will restore your health and hunger, and change your clothes. Is your house very small? You can acquire one of the properties for sale in the village or in the city.
